body.purpose: Running text; scales with the text-size setting via --step.

numeral.purpose: Roman numerals in the key helper only.

shadows.name: rail-indicator
shadows.purpose: Active rail item indicator (top edge on phones). Not elevation.

components.name: Button
components.description: Default action. Sturdy and plain, 44px minimum.
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-s, 6px); border: 1px solid var(--line, #cfd6de); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #1c2733); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: var(--ink-soft, #4d5b69); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #e69f00); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-s, 6px); border: 1px solid var(--accent, #0072b2); background: var(--accent, #0072b2); color: var(--accent-ink, #fff); font: inherit; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #e69f00); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9rem; } .ds-input { min-height: 44px; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-s, 6px); border: 1px solid var(--line, #cfd6de); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #1c2733); font: inherit; font-weight: 400; width: 5.5em; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #e69f00); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Mutually exclusive options; selected inverts to ink.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--line, #cfd6de); border-radius: var(--radius-s, 6px); overflow: hidden; background: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-seg button { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #1c2733); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button + button { border-left: 1px solid var(--line, #cfd6de); } .ds-seg button[aria-checked='true'] { background: var(--ink, #1c2733); color: var(--paper, #eef1f4); font-weight: 700; } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #e69f00); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Tag
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; font-size: 0.8rem; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--paper, #eef1f4); border: 1px solid var(--line, #cfd6de); color: var(--ink-soft, #4d5b69); }

components.name: Card
components.html: Find the noteTap every C on the neck.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 16px; background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--line, #cfd6de); border-radius: var(--radius-l, 14px); color: var(--ink, #1c2733); text-decoration: none; } .ds-card span { color: var(--ink-soft, #4d5b69); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--m-root, #d55e00); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #e69f00); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Rail Navigation
components.description: Icon-over-label rail; active item gets surface fill and an inset vermilion bar.
components.html: HomeExplore
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 96px; padding: 14px 8px; } .ds-rail a { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 10px 4px; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--ink-soft, #4d5b69); text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.8rem; min-height: 44px; } .ds-rail svg { fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-rail a.active { color: var(--ink, #1c2733); background: var(--surface, #fff); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--m-root, #d55e00); } .ds-rail a:hover { color: var(--ink, #1c2733); }

components.name: Fretboard Markers
components.description: Signature: rosewood neck with Okabe-Ito markers; every state also has a stroke cue.
components.html: <svg class="ds-fb" viewBox="0 0 300 90" width="300" height="90"><rect x="0" y="5" width="300" height="80" fill="#5a3826" stroke="#3f2619" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="4" y1="5" x2="4" y2="85" stroke="#ece6d8" stroke-width="7"/><line x1="100" y1="5" x2="100" y2="85" stroke="#c9ced6" stroke-width="3"/><line x1="200" y1="5" x2="200" y2="85" stroke="#c9ced6" stroke-width="3"/><line x1="0" y1="25" x2="300" y2="25" stroke="#dfe3e8"/><line x1="0" y1="65" x2="300" y2="65" stroke="#dfe3e8"/><circle cx="50" cy="25" r="13" fill="#d55e00" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="3"/><text x="50" y="30" text-anchor="middle" fill="#fff" font-size="13" font-weight="700">C</text><circle cx="150" cy="25" r="13" fill="#0072b2" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2"/><text x="150" y="30" text-anchor="middle" fill="#fff" font-size="13" font-weight="700">E</text><circle cx="250" cy="65" r="13" fill="#cc79a7" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/><text x="250" y="70" text-anchor="middle" fill="#fff" font-size="13" font-weight="700">G</text></svg>
components.css: .ds-fb { display: block; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: FretSense looks like a well-kept workbench. The surroundings are plain, cool and orderly: slate, paper and a single blue. The instrument on the bench is the only rich material in the room: a rosewood board, nickel frets, a bone nut and pearl inlays. Colour that carries meaning appears only as note markers on that board, and those markers use the Okabe-Ito palette so they stay distinguishable for colour-blind players.
keyCharacteristics: One neutral frame (slate top bar, icon rail, paper canvas) and one accent blue for actions and links.
The fretboard is drawn as a real instrument in SVG: rosewood, nickel, bone, pearl.
Okabe-Ito markers for root, tone, reference, correct, incorrect and revealed. State is never shown by colour alone.
One humanist, high-legibility typeface (Atkinson Hyperlegible Next) at two weights.
Flat surfaces, 1px borders, two radii. No shadows.

rules.name: The Instrument-Only Rule
rules.body: Wood, nickel, bone and pearl belong to the drawn neck and the brand mark. They never become UI chrome, backgrounds or buttons.

rules.name: The Never-Colour-Alone Rule
rules.body: Every marker or state colour is paired with a second cue: a dashed or dotted stroke, an icon, a text label, or border width. Removing the colour must leave the state readable.

rules.name: The Marker Meaning Rule
rules.body: An Okabe-Ito hue carries one meaning across the whole app. Vermilion is "root/selected", bluish-green is "correct/done". Don't reuse them for decoration.

rules.name: The One-Step Rule
rules.body: Type sizes are multiples of --step, never fixed px or rem, so the user's text-size setting scales everything.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Counts, tunings, fret ranges and stats use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Flat Bench Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. Use a border, a tonal surface step or a marker colour instead of a drop shadow.

dos: Do take every new colour from the tokens above. Add a token to :root and both dark blocks before using a new value.
Do pair every state colour with a stroke style, icon or text label (Never-Colour-Alone).
Do keep every interactive target at least 44 × 44px.
Do size type as a multiple of --step so the text-size setting reaches it.
Do draw instrument geometry from the InstrumentProfile, never a fixed 6 strings or fret count.
donts: Don't add drop shadows, glows or gradients. Depth is tonal (Flat Bench).
Don't use rosewood, nickel or pearl outside the drawn instrument and the brand mark.
Don't reuse a marker hue for something unrelated to its meaning.
Don't add a second accent colour or a second sans typeface.
Don't use a one-sided coloured stripe on a rounded box (the current .notice does this; it's flagged for replacement with a full border or tinted background).
